q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an LT electrical panel?
title: LT panel carbon footprint per panel
short: Weigh the sheet steel enclosure, copper or aluminium busbars and the bought-in breakers, meters and cables per panel, and multiply each by its supplier figure. Add cutting, bending, powder coating and wiring energy, divided by panels built.

ul: Breakers, contactors, meters, relays and cables.
Busbar fabrication, wiring and high voltage testing.

p: Report per panel with its rating and enclosure weight, since panels range from a small distribution board to a large main panel.

example.title: Worked example: LT panel unit per panel (one month)
lines: Plant total: 13,725 / 120 = 114.4 kg CO2 per panel
Add steel, busbars and switchgear for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
